verdict.rationale: The evidence pack covers verification flows, review tools, and access to results, but contains no documentation of data retention policies, deletion controls, or user-initiated data removal/export mechanisms for AI-native or any users. Community commentary raises concern about data security/trust (comm-8) but does not confirm any retention/deletion controls exist. Missing for 10: any documentation of retention periods, deletion APIs/endpoints, data export or right-to-erasure workflows, or AI-agent-specific controls over stored ID data.
